image_description: A close-up studio shot of a green cucumber that has been partially sliced. The main body of the cucumber is in the foreground on the left, showing its dark green skin and pale interior where cut. Behind it are three distinct circular slices arranged in a receding line, displaying the internal seed structure and flesh texture against a stark white background.
